'''Kalifa''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiate]] who once studied to become a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knight]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the final years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During her training however, Kalifa was abducted by [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] hunters and taken to the [[Trandosha/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]], [[Wasskah/Legends|Wasskah]], where she was tirelessly hunted by her captors.

==Biography==
{{Quote|It's ok. I can make it...''"<br />"''Kalifa!|Kalifa and Ahsoka as the former is fatally shot|<ref name="PL" />}}
Entering into the [[Jedi academy|academy]], Kalifa became part of a [[Clan (Jedi)/Legends|clan]] of several other [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiates]] as she attended classes and studied the arts of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. Approaching the end of her training at the academy at the start of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Kalifa was away from Coruscant when she was abducted by [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] slavers and transported to the moon of [[Wasskah/Legends|Wasskah]] along with fellow Initiates [[O-Mer/Legends|O-Mer]] and [[Jinx/Legends|Jinx]].<ref name="PL" />

Released into the wilds of [[Island Four/Legends|Island Four]], the three Initiates evaded their captors, who constantly hunted them for sport. Sleeping in caves and tree hollows by night, the group was constantly on the move to avoid being tracked. Over the course of their imprisonment, they encountered at least one captured [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] who eventually got themselves killed by the Trandoshans trying to confront them. Kalifa and her fellows were forced to forsake the Jedi role of protectors. If they tried to help the other prisoners, they would all certainly be killed. It wasn't until the Padawan [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] was captured and brought to the moon that the Initiates began to remember their training and take the offensive.<ref name="PL" />
[[File:KalifaShot-PL.jpg|thumb|left|220px|Kalifa shot through the heart]]

Searching for the [[Ubrikkian floating fortress|Trandoshan base]], the four Jedi-in-training were ambushed and divided into two groups. As Tano and Kalifa raced into the jungle, they were followed by a young Trandoshan hunter, [[Dar/Legends|Dar]], who managed to send Kalifa tumbling into the underbrush. Dar was then granted the kill opportunity by his father and pursued the two Force-sensitives. After a brief bout of hand-to-hand combat, the two Jedi managed to impale the Trandoshan on a jungle plant. As Tano helped Kalifa to her feet, Kalifa was struck in the back with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bolt by a vengeful [[Garnac/Legends|Garnac]] through the heart and collapsed. Taking cover, Tano stood with Kalifa as her life faded, promising to protect the others and lead them off the planet. When Kalifa was dead, Tano raced off, leaving her body on top of the crook of a tree root.<ref name="PL" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kalifa appeared in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' episode "[[Padawan Lost]]," where she was voiced by [[Gwendoline Yeo]].
